snippet.title: Trailer our new game - Roll Dice no Die! #rolldicenodie #steam #wishlistonsteam #games #dice
snippet.description:
🎲 WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM

Welcome to the Board Game Hell. "Roll Dice no Die" turns the familiar dice-rolling and board-moving mechanics into a tense, psychological survival thriller. 
Take your seat on the electric chair opposite the Master - a terrifying automaton made of three skulls and a steel manipulator. Your currency is the lightbulbs on your life support panel. 
Every wrong step sends a massive electric shock through your body.
Lose your last lightbulb, and it’s game over.

🎮 KEY FEATURES:
Dark Steampunk Atmosphere: The grinding of rusty gears, the hiss of steam, and the neon glow of vacuum lamps in an underground bar.

Deckbuilding & Synergies: Use your Death Row Deck to modify dice values, force the robot to skip turns, or bluff your way out of a lethal shock.

Infinite Replayability: Randomly generated cards, a dynamically changing board, and unpredictable AI behavior make every match unique.

Roguelite Meta-Progression: Unlock new pawns and rare cards to build your ultimate deck for the next run.

🔥 Don't forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE for more gamedev updates!
